title: 5 What thinges are contrarie to matrimonie.

segments.text: VNTO matrimonie are contrarie, fornications, adulteries, inceſts, vnlawful copulation, abuſes of marriage, & diuorces not in caſe of adulterie. But the perſon that is forſaken, or is ſolicited to admit a forſaking, doth not cauſe the diuorce, but the other.
